title: Mixed Event — An Ode for the Pure of Heart — Episode5 For This Upcoming Show

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
meta.Event Outline: Toya suddenly ends up taking on a role as a wedding flash mob extra. But when he arrives at the venue, unexpected circumstances mean that the director is nowhere to be seen. As the possibility of a canceled show grows greater by the second, Toya meets Rui...

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we have those roles filled, we'll need to choose who will be leading the dance part next.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Hey, you really have this under control...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I'm not sure what you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Your directing.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: It feels all wrong. We're already short on time and you're just deciding who does what based on what they happen to be able to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, there's no need for any auditioning if that's what you're asking.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I chose those who I believe will do this ceremony the most justice.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: That's just your opinion, kid. They don't really know much about acting either from what I can tell...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: I'm in a theatre troupe and I've been doing this for a while now. Someone with more experience and acting skills would be a better choice, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Acting skills, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, everybody here is more or less the same in terms of that...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that some people are indeed born actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Their presence, how they go about themselves day to day, it all sets them apart from the rest of us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But only so many of them actually exist.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Then what the hell are you trying to do here...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do not have this sort of ace in the hole, so I'm relying on your natural talents to make the most of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unless you are that very star we need right now. Are you?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
What?! You...!
How can you say that when you clearly don't have much experience doing this...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point. However, I also know that experience only begins to matter after you've reached a certain level.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then, we have little time to spare. Next, we'll need to...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
I can't deal with this guy!
I'm outta here...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?! Please, wait...!
se_event_bridal_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He really left...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is awkward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping that he wouldn't cause such a fuss if what he said about being in a theatre troupe were true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure about just letting him go? We'll be down a person...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is less than ideal...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we don't have a choice. We don't have the luxury to worry about this right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'll need the dance lead to sing as well. Would anyone like to volunteer?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh dear. They've all gone quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Leading the dance is just as important as being one of the men proposing to the bride...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But today's ceremony is being held outside. There won't be much in the way of lights or acoustics to help cover up mistakes, so someone with good fundamentals would be best for this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our leaver was my leading candidate, but I'm guessing he also would've let things go to his head and caused trouble for everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only there were someone here with experience singing and dancing in front of a crowd...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Singing and dancing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There is someone that could help us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So what did you call me over for...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe Akito will be able to lead the dance portion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, please. I beg you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tell me... What's in it for me if I do say yes to this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Listen, Toya. I'm not doing a gig for some wedding or anything like that, so find someone else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For some wedding, eh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's how you truly feel, then I won't recommend that you join us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To you, this may be just another uninteresting stage or venue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But to the bride and groom, this is a once-in-a-lifetime event. If you're unable to see that, then I won't ask you to participate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose that this role may be too much for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're just egging me on to join now, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I really don't like people who try to manipulate others into doing stuff for them like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, so I've been made.
Please excuse my indiscretion.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're still grinning...
You don't actually feel bad, do you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In actuality, who knows...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now you're just trying to start something, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I am simply trying to give this ceremony the show that it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'll do anything right now if it means convincing you to join us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel no guilt over that whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So that's how it is...
But I still don't like it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not agreeing to this if it means working with someone like him. Got it, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand...
I'm sorry, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for inviting you without actually thinking about it first.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's the night festival all over again. I relied on you too much that time too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's different...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But please just know this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro took over as the director for this performance pro bono.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The real director ran into some trouble and couldn't make it in time today. For a moment, everything was set to be cancelled.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the bride has been planning this for quite some time all just to see her fiancé smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to make this happen if it really means that much to them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And Kamishiro feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He wants this to succeed no matter what for the bride's sake. Please, try to understand at least that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for dumping this on you so suddenly. I promise to pay you back later...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, what do I need to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll do it. You happy now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't like the way you do things, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I know that feeling of wanting to make something happen no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is for Toya, not you, got it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand. I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This means you owe me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
I promise to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, we need to start rehearsing.
Do you have the time, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's 12:30... We only have an hour and a half until it starts?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?! An hour and a half?!
Dude, you serious?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, very!
We'll need to get started right away, Shinonome! The costumes are all ready...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Aoyagi...
Have you ever thought about appearing from the sky...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
T-The sky...?!
No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold up!
What are you up to now?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was just a joke.
We need to go! Hurry!
